utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I thought I saw a notice, but now I'm not sure. Did you hear anything official?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Not really official, just bits and pieces from people.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: So it might not be happening? I really need to know for sure.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hey Quinn, have you heard about the neighborhood repair drive this Saturday? I'm thinking of bringing my old toaster!

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That's awesome, Tess! I bet someone can fix that toaster in no time. Hey, could you help me spread the word to a few more neighbors?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sure thing, Quinn! I've already mentioned it to Kira and Faye, but I can remind them again, or knock on a few more doors.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, is that the repair drive everyone's been talking about? I've heard bits and pieces.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes, it's a community effort to fix up some shared spaces. I'm helping coordinate times. Want to join in?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That sounds nice! What kind of stuff are we fixing, and do you know what time it starts?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I'm certain it's this weekend, Maria told me.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, I'm in. What repairs are we doing first?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: We're starting with old electronics, like radios and toasters. Maria said we'll have a station for each type.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before I can answer, can you tell me what specifically is broken? I want to be sure I have the right information.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hmm, I'm not sure—I just heard something about a van. What's broken?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: A van? I thought we were talking about tools for the community center. Can you tell me more about this van?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Kira! Just a reminder, the repair drive is next Saturday. Got any broken items you'd like to bring?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, are you sure about that? I haven't seen any official notices around.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, it's definitely next Saturday! I put up flyers at the community center and the laundromat, maybe they got covered. I'll send you a quick reminder text with the details too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let's make sure we have a date set before we go anywhere.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Uh, I thought we were meeting at the garage now. What date do you mean?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: No, Sam, we haven't agreed on a date yet. We need to pick one first before we head anywhere.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Mina! I'm trying to sort out the repair drive times. Saturday might be tricky because of soccer games.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Sunday afternoon works for me—what about you?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sunday afternoon sounds perfect! I can manage that around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive? I think I heard something about that... but I can't remember the details. Do you know what we're supposed to do?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It's on Elm Street, starting at 2 PM. That's tentative, but we should head over soon.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Elm Street, 2 PM? Right, I think I've got it now... but uh, what exactly are we fixing?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Noah, have you heard about the repair drive for the garden shed?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Wait, I thought the repair drive was for electronics this weekend. Did I miss something about the garden shed?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No, I'm pretty sure it's the garden shed roof that's been leaking. Maybe there are two different drives?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Mara, I've been tallying supplies for the repair drive this weekend. We're a bit low on parts, so we'll need to prioritize.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Ah, I see. My toaster might not be top priority then—maybe we focus on things with quick fixes first?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Exactly, Mara. Quick fixes like patching leaks or small electronics can save resources for the big repairs.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Leo, I heard about the repair drive. I've got some tools I can lend if you need any.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Gus. It's next Saturday, bring your tools then.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, I'll be there with my tools. Anything specific you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I'm with Noah—I really thought it was next weekend. But Maria told me it's this weekend, so I guess we're fixing electronics then.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh Vik, I think there's a mix-up! The repair drive is actually next Saturday, not this weekend. Let me send out a reminder to everyone to clear up the date.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Oh, so it's next Saturday? Got it, I'll let others know.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, I think I heard 2 PM too, but we're still waiting on the date and location.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Well, before we finalize, we need to check if we have enough supplies. I'd hate to start and run out of paint or screws.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That's a good point, Pia. Let's make a list of what we have and what we need before setting a date.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yeah, the roof's been a real headache. I'm worried it'll get worse if we don't patch it soon.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Maybe the repair drive this Saturday could help with that? I've heard they're fixing up all sorts of things.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I guess I could give it a shot, but I'd feel bad asking for help with something so big.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, Kira, I wish I could help, but I can't seem to remember what I'm supposed to do. Did we pick a day for this thing?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Are you sure there's a repair drive? I haven't heard anything official.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Hmm, maybe I dreamed it up. I thought I had a list somewhere...

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Next Saturday, not today.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Oh, next Saturday. That gives us time to gather tools.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Meet at my garage at 9 AM Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Ira, we're doing a repair drive this weekend. Want to help out at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure, I heard about that. Is it for the garden shed roof?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: No, it's for fixing up old electronics and appliances. Mara's organizing sign-ups at the community center this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I've got wrenches, screwdrivers, hammers, a drill set, and even a welding kit if that helps.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Wow, Gus, that's quite a collection! Your welding kit might be overkill for my toaster, but I'm sure it'll come in handy for someone else's project.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, maybe save the welding for something bigger. But those screwdrivers and wrenches are yours if you need 'em.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Hey Mina, I'm checking the supplies for the repair drive—do you know anyone who has extra roofing material we could borrow?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I don't know offhand—what kind of roofing material do you need?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: We're mostly looking for asphalt shingles, but any kind of weatherproof roofing would help.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Good morning, Tess! Are you heading to the repair drive on Elm Street?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yes, I am! I'm bringing my old toaster that's been acting up—hope they can fix it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, great! Just a heads up, I think it starts at 2 PM, so you might have to wait a bit. It's the white van with the orange stripe—I can show you if you like.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, I thought it was next month. Are you sure it's this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Yeah, it's definitely this Saturday! I'm heading up the invitation list—hope you can make it!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, okay, Saturday it is. I'll try to clear my schedule, but you know how it is—things slip my mind.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yeah, I'm just about to head to Leo's garage to help with that repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Oh, perfect timing! Let me know if you need to adjust for school drop-offs later.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Will do, thanks for thinking of that. I'll keep an eye on the time.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Hana, sorry I'm late. What did I miss about the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Dane, I'm trying to get a clear picture of what needs fixing—Mina mentioned tools and equipment at the community center are busted, but I'm not sure which ones. Do you have more details?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I'm not sure either, Hana—I haven't checked the community center recently. Maybe we can swing by together to see what's broken?

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
